import os,glob,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

import os,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
for pair in [1,2]:
    i,o=G[f'Demo pair {pair} input'],G[f'Demo pair {pair} output']
    print('pair',pair)
    ones=[(r,c) for r in range(len(i)) for c in range(len(i[0])) if o[r][c]==1]
    threes=[(r,c) for r in range(len(i)) for c in range(len(i[0])) if i[r][c]==3]
    twos=[(r,c) for r in range(len(i)) for c in range(len(i[0])) if i[r][c]==2]
    print('ones:',ones)
    # bounding box of ones
    rs=[r for r,c in ones]; cs=[c for r,c in ones]
    print('one bbox rows',min(rs),max(rs),'cols',min(cs),max(cs))
    print('three bbox rows',min(r for r,c in threes),max(r for r,c in threes),'cols',min(c for r,c in threes),max(c for r,c in threes))
    print('two bbox rows',min(r for r,c in twos),max(r for r,c in twos),'cols',min(c for r,c in twos),max(c for r,c in twos))

def lines(g):
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0]);bl=[]
    for c in range(W):
        run=[r for r in range(H) if g[r][c]==2]
        if len(run)>=2: bl.append(('v',c,min(run),max(run)))
    for r in range(H):
        run=[c for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==2]
        if len(run)>=2: bl.append(('h',r,min(run),max(run)))
    return bl

def feat(r,c,g,O):
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0])
    b=comps_of(g,3)
    bl=lines(g)
    F={}
    # nearest box center
    best=None;bd=1e9
    for kx,bx in enumerate(b):
        rs=[x for x,_ in bx];cs=[y for _,y in bx]
        cr=(min(rs)+max(rs))/2;cc=(min(cs)+max(cs))/2
        d=abs(r-cr)+abs(c-cc)
        if d<bd: bd=d;bc=(cr,cc);bk=kx
    F['dbox']=bd;F['boxid']=bk
    # distance to each line (signed)
    dl={}
    for typ,pos,a,bk_ in bl:
        if typ=='v': d=c-pos; dl[f'dv{pos}']=d
        else: d=r-pos; dl[f'dh{pos}']=d
    # betweenness: is c between two vline pos?
    vp=[p for t,p,a,bk_ in bl if t=='v']
    hp=[p for t,p,a,bk_ in bl if t=='h']
    F['betv']=any(min(vp)<=c<=max(vp)) if len(vp)>=2 else False
    F['betht']=False
    # row/col bands
    F['rowband']=min(hp)<=r<=max(hp) if len(hp)>=2 else False
    F['colband']=min(vp)<=c<=max(vp) if len(vp)>=2 else False
    # parity
    F['par']= (r+c)%2
    # neighbors painted/inbox/line
    nb=[]
    for dx in(-1,0,1):
        for dy in(-1,0,1):
            x,y=r+dx,c+dy
            if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W:
                v=g[x][y]
                if v==1: nb.append('p')
                elif v==2: nb.append('l')
                elif v==3: nb.append('b')
    F['nbpainted']=nb.count('p'); F['nblines']=nb.count('l'); F['nbboxes']=nb.count('b')
    # is cell on a line?
    F['onlin']=any(typ=='v' and c==pos for typ,pos,a,bk_ in bl) or any(typ=='h' and r==pos for typ,pos,a,bk_ in bl)
    # is cell adjacent to box (chebyshev dist 1 to box cells)
    F['adjbox']=any(abs(x-r)<=1 and abs(y-c)<=1 for x,y in b[bk])
    return F

def lines(g):
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0]);bl=[]
    for c in range(W):
        run=[r for r in range(H) if g[r][c]==2]
        if len(run)>=2: bl.append(('v',c,min(run),max(run)))
    for r in range(H):
        run=[c for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==2]
        if len(run)>=2: bl.append(('h',r,min(run),max(run)))
    return bl

def feat(r,c,g):
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0])
    b=comps_of(g,3); bl=lines(g)
    F={}
    best=None;bd=1e9
    for kx,bx in enumerate(b):
        rs=[x for x,_ in bx];cs=[y for _,y in bx]
        cr=(min(rs)+max(rs))/2;cc=(min(cs)+max(cs))/2
        d=abs(r-cr)+abs(c-cc)
        if d<bd: bd=d;bk=kx
    F['dbox']=round(bd,6)
    vp=[p for t,p,a,b_ in bl if t=='v']; hp=[p for t,p,a,b_ in bl if t=='h']
    F['vp']=vp;F['hp']=hp
    F['onv']=c in vp
    F['onh']=r in hp
    F['betv']=len(vp)>=2 and min(vp)<=c<=max(vp)
    # signed distance to nearest v-line
    dv=min([abs(c-p) for t,p,a,b_ in bl if t=='v'], default=99)
    dh=min([abs(r-p) for t,p,a,b_ in bl if t=='h'], default=99)
    F['dv']=dv;F['dh']=dh
    F['gapv']=c-min(vp) if c>=min(vp) else -(c-max(vp)) if c<=max(vp) else 99
    F['gaph']=r-min(hp) if r>=min(hp) else -(r-max(hp)) if r<=max(hp) else 99
    F['adj2']=any(abs(x-r)<=1 and abs(y-c)<=1 and g[x][y]==2 for x,y in [(x,y) for bx in b for x,y in bx])
    F['nb2']=sum(1 for dx in(-1,0,1) for dy in(-1,0,1) if (dx or dy) and 0<=r+dx<H and 0<=c+dy<W and g[r+dx][c+dy]==2)
    return F

Demo 3: box (6,4), painted row 6 cols 0-2 and 6-11, vertical 2-line at col 4. Painted = row 6 except cells of the line itself? Actually col 4 is the line so painted excludes it; other columns painted fully both directions. So rule for demo3: paint entire horizontal line through the box center... but only row 6, not others. Hmm.

Demo 2: two boxes (2,3),(11,9); vertical 2-lines at cols 3,7,11,16(? input shows 2s at cols 3 and 9 rows ~0-... let's look: col 3 has 2s rows 0..14 and col 9 also 2s. Painted in demo2: rings around each box with radius growing, truncated at lines? Box (2,3): painted rings 2..8ish extending rightward until hitting col-7/col-9 2-lines? Ring extents: ring 2 [(0,-2),(0,2)] → cols 1,5; up to ring 8 [-8,0]... (-8,0) means row -8? no—rel offset (dr,dc)=(-8,0) means r=br-8=−6?? That can't be. But printed rel offsets use (br,bc) wrong. Whatever.

Let me instead directly analyze the picture: painted cells form diamond rings around each box center, extended until hitting a 2-line or boundary. In demo 3, box center (6,4) lies ON the vertical 2-line (col 4 rows 6...). The vertical line extends full column height through center. Painting extends horizontally away... row 6 painted everywhere else. Hmm but then why does it stop at row 6 only, not extend vertically down/up to edge? Row 6 painting covers full width both sides; vertical extent none. Interesting: maybe the ring expands along the perpendicular... 

Actually reconsider demo 1: box (1,5) center (2,5)? No wait demo1 box top-left (0,4)? Input rows: row0 '....333...' → box rows 0-2 cols 4-6, center (1,5). But also side cells like (5,4),(5,5),(5,6): rel (4,0),(4,1),(4,-1) d=4,5. So ring d=4 includes (4,1) rel → (5,6)? That's dr=4,dc=1 d=5. Fine mixed. So diamond "tall" version: cells within Manhattan distance ≤R from center restricted to column strip |dc|≤1? But demo3: painted entire row 6 all columns (dc large). Inconsistent...

Unless demo3's shape differs because the vertical 2-line blocks vertical expansion while the box is centered on it. Maybe rule: ring expands until blocked by 2-lines. Demo3: vertical line through center blocks vertical growth; horizontal 2-line? There's none horizontal in demo3 (rows 6 only). So horizontal growth unrestricted → full row. Demo1: vertical 2-line? col2 rows: row1 all 2s → horizontal line at row 1 passing through center (1,5)? Block upward expansion: nothing above painted (dr negative missing). Downward grows to edge. But why dc restricted to ±1 in demo1... in demo3 dc unrestricted. Hmm.

Wait — maybe dc restriction comes from something else. Demo1 painted dc∈{-1,0,1}; demo3 dc unlimited; demo2 mix. What distinguishes? Perhaps the vertical 2-lines: demo1 has horizontal line row 1; demo2 has vertical lines col 3 and col 9; demo3 vertical col 4; demo4 vertical col 3 and col 10? Painted includes (0,4),(1,4): column 4 above box center (vertical expansion!). And (7,3),(7,5),(7,9)... hmm ring structures.

import collections
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    I=G[k+' input']; O=G[k+' output']
    H=len(I);W=len(I[0])
    lrows=[r for r in range(H) if any((I[r][c]==2 and I[r][c+1]==2 and I[r][c+2]==2) for c in range(W-2))]
    vcols=[c for c in range(W) if any((I[r][c]==2 and I[r+1][c]==2 and I[r+2][c]==2) for r in range(H-2))]
    boxes=[(br,bc) for br in range(H-2) for bc in range(W-2)
           if sum(1 for dr in range(3) for dc in range(3) if I[br+dr][bc+dc]==3)==8 and I[br+1][bc+1]==2]
    paint=set((r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]!=O[r][c])
    comps=[];seen=set()
    for p in paint:
        if p in seen: continue
        comp=[];dq=collections.deque([p]);seen.add(p)
        while dq:
            r,c=dq.popleft();comp.append((r,c))
            for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                q=(r+dr,c+dc)
                if q in paint and q not in seen: seen.add(q);dq.append(q)
        comps.append(comp)
    print('==',k,'centers(mean painted):',[collections.mean([r for r,_ in c]),collections.mean([c for _,c in c]) for c in comps],
          'boxes:',boxes,'lines:',lrows,vcols)

import itertools
def analyze(k):
    I=G[k+' input']; O=G[k+' output']
    H=len(I);W=len(I[0])
    twos={(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]==2}
    boxes=[(br,bc) for br in range(H-2) for bc in range(W-2)
           if sum(1 for dr in range(3) for dc in range(3) if I[br+dr][bc+dc]==3)==8 and I[br+1][bc+1]==2]
    bmarkers={(br+1,bc+1) for br,bc in boxes}
    paint=set((r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]!=O[r][c])
    return I,O,H,W,twos,boxes,bmarkers,paint
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    I,O,H,W,twos,boxes,bmarks,paint=analyze(k)
    # hypothesis A: painted iff min manhattan dist to (twos U bmarks) <= 2, EXCLUDING cells of the lines themselves (2-cells belonging to runs >=3)?
    def predA(cell):
        r,c=cell
        if I[r][c]==2:
            # is this 2 part of a run>=3?
            runs=any((r,c)==(r,x) and I[r][x]==2 and x!=c for x in range(max(0,c-1),min(W,c+2))) or False
            hrun=sum(1 for x in range(max(0,c-1),min(W,c+2)) if I[r][x]==2)-1>=2
            vrun=sum(1 for y in range(max(0,r-1),min(H,r+2)) if I[y][c]==2)-1>=2
            if hrun or vrun: return False
        d=min(abs(r-tr)+abs(c-tc) for tr,tc in twos|bmarks)
        return d<=2
    print(k,'A:',predA(set()) if False else all(predA((r,c))==((r,c) in paint) for r in range(H) for c in range(W)))

import math
def clusters(k):
    I,O=G[k+' input'],G[k+' output']
    H=len(I);W=len(I[0])
    paint=set((r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]==0 and O[r][c]==1)
    # connected components of paint (4-conn)
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for p in paint:
        if p in seen: continue
        st=[p]; comp=[]
        while st:
            q=st.pop()
            if q in seen: continue
            seen.add(q); comp.append(q)
            for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                n=(q[0]+dr,q[1]+dc)
                if n in paint and n not in seen: st.append(n)
        comps.append(comp)
    return comps
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    print('===',k)
    for comp in clusters(k):
        rows=[r for r,c in comp]; cols=[c for r,c in comp]
        # try fit: is it diamond d<=R around some center? find center via mode of (r+c)//2 etc
        print('size',len(comp),'bbox rows',min(rows),max(rows),'cols',min(cols),max(cols))
        # candidate centers: check if comp == {(r,c): |r-rc|+|c-cc|<=R} intersect... just print shape
        for rr in range(min(rows),max(rows)+1):
            print('   ',''.join('#' if (rr,c) in set(comp) else '.' for c in range(min(cols),max(cols)+1)))
